text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Spring Stakes. The long distance would have been hard for Mihono Bourbon to complete before her debut, but now she can run it at full power.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's full of confidence for the race but says that if she fails to win it, she's willing to change course for her future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The curtains rise on the Spring Stakes, the stepping stone to the Satsuki Sho.
